objectives.label: Bail out
objectives.text: Tug 9 is being shot down with you in it. Out the back and down onto Receiving Pad 3. Steer, shoot what comes up at you, and roll (jump) out of the way of missiles.

objectives.label: Repo-Man
objectives.text: The gunship came down after you. Shoot it down or ride it out: when the missile warning goes, roll.

objectives.label: Pad crew
objectives.text: Somebody was on a smoke break out here. He is going for the alarm.

objectives.label: Up the gangway
objectives.text: FOINT keeps something enormous in there, and it is plugged into everything. Head up the gangway.

objectives.label: Yard security
objectives.text: Drone bays are opening and a dropship is setting security down in the east yard. Shoot the drones down. The red fuel cells blow.

objectives.label: Jump the crevasse
objectives.text: Jump the crevasse to the east yard.

objectives.label: Freight hauler
objectives.text: More drones coming up by the stairs. Use the freight hauler for cover. Shoot the fuel cells when they bunch up.

objectives.label: Upper walkway
objectives.text: Take the stairs up to the north walkway.

objectives.label: Walkway drones
objectives.text: More drone bays on the walkway. Clear them, then cross the bridge.

objectives.label: Crane tower
objectives.text: Cross the bridge and get into the crane tower.

objectives.label: West door
objectives.text: Through the inspection bay and out the west door to the cableway. Jump, tap A again in the air and hold it to burn.

stages.task: Cross the magma to Checkpoint Gamma.

objectives.label: Pylon 1
objectives.text: The old cableway. Burn across to the first pylon.

objectives.label: Pylon 2 (live)
objectives.text: The next deck is wired into the Draw: when the lights stutter, get off it.

objectives.label: Pylon 3
objectives.text: Keep moving.

objectives.label: The tram
objectives.text: Pylon 4 is gone and the cable with it. There is a freight tram at the Loop 2 siding beside this pylon: step onto its bed.

objectives.label: The loop
objectives.text: The brakes are gone and it is not stopping. Drones off the pylons, goons on the signal gantry, a heavy on the rail. Stay on the bed.

objectives.label: Checkpoint Gamma
objectives.text: It is coming in through the railing at Gamma and it will not stop. Get off before it hits the frame.

stages.name: Dead Cableway

objectives.label: Checkpoint security
objectives.text: The shift room is emptying. Lure the heavies onto the green plates and let the Draw cook them. The goons wear rubber boots: the plates do nothing to them.

objectives.label: Gate clamps
objectives.text: The gate is clamped shut. Shoot out the two glowing pressure valves on the lock rams.

objectives.label: Manual release
objectives.text: Clamps are off. Pull the manual release lever.

objectives.label: Omnisphere access
objectives.text: The gate is open. Get inside.

objectives.label: Quarterly review
objectives.text: The freight door is opening: a heavy formation. Mind the presses: they flatten anything on the belt. When the line goes haywire, the bodies on the hooks swing across the floor: time your crossings.

objectives.label: To the docks
objectives.text: North door, out to the freight docks.

objectives.label: Gunship
objectives.text: GUNSHIP. Rockets do the job; the FOINT-N-SHOOT station at the west end of the dock restocks them. Red rings mark where its missiles land. Use the containers.

objectives.label: Bridge lock
objectives.text: The bridge north is raised. Three glowing yellow emitters hold its lock: shoot all three and it comes down.

objectives.label: The bridge
objectives.text: Bridge is down. Cross to containment.

objectives.label: Containment door
objectives.text: CONTAINMENT 01 is sealed behind SCHLEEDTECH BLACK ICE. Jack into the terminal beside the door (E / pad B) and ride the data line to the core: hop, jump, duck, and do not fall off.

objectives.label: Containment
objectives.text: Juniper is through that door.

objectives.label: Juniper
objectives.text: There he is. Somebody is sitting with him: press X to talk, or walk up to the plinth to start.

objectives.label: Wrist cuffs
objectives.text: Shoot both glowing seals on each of his four wrist cuffs. Security will keep coming: every arm you free fights with you. Every cuff that comes off lets his current loose across the floor: get up on the plinth or in the air. It cooks the robots; the goons wear rubber boots.

objectives.label: The belt
objectives.text: The belt. Shoot its two seals.

objectives.label: The breach
objectives.text: The bridge is gone. He made his own door: through the hole in the west wall, and keep out from under him.

objectives.label: Up the outside
objectives.text: Maintenance brackets up the shell to the conduit gantry. The rusted ones tear loose: land, jump, burn.

objectives.label: The siphon conduit
objectives.text: Run the top of the conduit to the sphere. When the line flares and the whine climbs, a surge is coming down it: be in the air when it passes you.

objectives.label: Over the podium
objectives.text: The line over the podium is shearing off its supports. Keep running. He is right under it.

objectives.label: The feed riser
objectives.text: The conduit feeds the riser on the far side of the sphere: that tower lifts his current up to the ring round the sphere. Follow it.

objectives.label: The service lift
objectives.text: Step into the lift cage. It goes all the way up. Hold on.

objectives.label: Up the riser
objectives.text: The hoist is gone. Maintenance ledges up the tower: jump, burn, keep going.

objectives.label: The containment ring
objectives.text: Across the feed bridge and drop onto the ring. It turns: it carries you with it.

objectives.label: Field emitters
objectives.text: Three field emitters hold his current in the core. Their shutters open to vent: shoot the capacitor bank inside while they are open.

objectives.label: Field emitters
objectives.text: One down. Two to go.

objectives.label: Field emitters
objectives.text: The last emitter. Then the whole thing lets go.

objectives.label: Jump
objectives.text: The ring is going. Your ride is right under you: over the railing and jump.
